name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon lies curled on a shelf of blue ice, tail wrapped around its treasure, head raised and turned toward the camera with a cool, imperious gaze, frost-breath drifting from its nostrils.
components.background: a vaulted ice cavern deep beneath a glacier, towering blue ice columns, shafts of pale light filtering down through the ice
components.hoard: coins, crowns and jewelled goblets frozen inside blocks of clear ice, frost-rimed swords and shields, heaps of uncut diamonds and snowflake crystals, a few glittering frozen relics
components.effects: A few fine ice crystals glitter in the air above the hoard - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
